rationale: Verse 47/76 contains the exact quoted sequence Hano fayəš mdawmro w qimo w məlle: Šubḥolux aloho. Verse 47/77 instead begins Kali qimo and describes the king remaining standing until the service finishes.

data.turoyo: Mqabəl diḏa ste kətyo Mor Abrohom. Ġalabe ʕitoṯe heš me meqəm w ʕeloye, mdawmrina w mʕaǧbina ġalabe ʕal ab baniyataṯṯe w ʕal u šəklaṯṯe w ʕal a dkoṯe, d kətwayne mqadše w daʕ ʕabode, d ʕəbdiwa appe.
data.translation: Ihm gegenüber liegt auch Mar Abraham und viele alte, hochgelegene Kirben noch von früher, und wir bestaunten und bewunderten ihren Bau und ihre Gestalt und die Orte, die heilig waren und an denen die Gottesanbeter Gott anzubeten pflegten.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Preterit; first-person plural experiencers and explicit ʕal- stimulus.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (105/52)

data.turoyo: w ḥəlla: nafəq tloṯ abnoṯe zarif manne w ġalabe layəq w fayišo mʕaǧabto w mdawmarto mi masalaṯi. Məlla: “Haṯi mə masale yo?”
data.translation: Die Mutter sah drei hübsche Jungfrauen herauskommen und wunderte sich höchlichst über diese Sache. Was ist das für eine Geschichte? -

rationale: Thin Part. Pass.; feminine mdawmarto with m- stimulus, contrasting with inherited masculine forms.

summary: All supplied forms belong to the entry's Detransitive paradigm; they express amazement with an experiencer subject, not an external agent acting on a patient.
Finite mdawmrina contrasts with state mdawmro/mdawmarto after fayəš. Conjoined mʕaǧb- is a parallel predicate, not a light-verb construction.
Preserve inherited stemI and base mdawmər/midawmər; semantic overlap with dmr does not justify moving quadriliteral-shaped forms or renaming the stem without paradigmatic evidence.
Confirm whether m- and ʕal- stimuli differ semantically or are freely selected in this experiencer construction.
Verify whether dwmr and dmr should be cross-referenced as form variants; this job does not establish identity and proposes no merger.
47/66 German renders mdawmri only with sagten; retain the existing translated example but check whether the edition omits amazement deliberately.

rationale: In auf's höchste erstaunt, verblüfft sein, erstaunt is a predicative participle/adjective and requires lowercase.

summary: Experiencer subjects include a group admiring buildings and a woman astonished by an event; stimulus is coded by ʕal- or m-.
